progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = sorted(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg))
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in pts); c1 = max(c for r, c in pts)
        # Fill the open interior of a rectangular outline.
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if not all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)):
            continue
        if not all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            continue
        fill = 7 if ((r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)) % 2 else 2
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
